newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY RADIO NOON HEADLINES - NOV 25.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY RADIO NOON HEADLINES - NOV 25.

text.p: These are the main headlines on Hungary's Kossuth Radio midday news. Reuters cannot vouch for their accuracy:
- The fate of Hungary's ambassador Antal Annus, who was on board the crashed Ethiopian airliner is still unknown.
- The Energy Council has fears that a restructuring of energy tarrifs would mean an addition price increase compared with the January government figures.
- Taszar resident complain about a TV-comedy on them.
- RMDSZ can expect to have the tourism ministry in the new Romanian government.
- Hungary and Poland could fulfil NATO membership requirements if they coordinate tactical steps.
